export.title: My data
export.intro: Download your most important data from the app as a single file – to keep or take with you. It is in JSON format and opens in any text editor.
export.scope: This download does not replace a complete access response under Article 15 GDPR. You can request further information using the contact in your profile under “Help”.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Your profile, occasions and wishes will be deleted immediately and for good. Guests will no longer see your occasions, and your reservations on other lists will be canceled.

sheet.title: Notifications
sheet.intro: Bunprise lets you know when someone invites you to an occasion – even when the app is closed.
sheet.preview_label: This is what a notification looks like
sheet.privacy: It only says who invites you and the occasion’s title. There are never notifications about reservations. You can switch them off any time, here or in your browser.
sheet.device_hint: Only for this device and until you sign out.
sheet.invitations_hint: When someone invites you to an occasion (on all your devices)
sheet.allow_note: Your browser will ask once more – tap “Allow” there.
sheet.demo: Demo: there are no real notifications here – this is what one would look like.
sheet.denied_body: Notifications for Bunprise were declined. You can allow them in your browser’s site settings (the icon left of the address) or in your phone’s settings.
sheet.ios_title: Only from the home screen app
sheet.ios_body: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only arrive when you open Bunprise from the home screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
sheet.ios_step_1: In Safari, tap “Share” at the bottom.
sheet.ios_step_3: Open Bunprise from there and switch notifications on here.
sheet.unsupported_body: This browser cannot receive notifications. A current Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari can.
sheet.unavailable: Notifications are not available right now. Please try again later.
sheet.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again.

hint.text: Get new invitations on your phone right away?

calendar_feed.title: Calendar subscription
calendar_feed.intro: Your occasions appear in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook by themselves — including the ones you’re invited to. Changes follow automatically.
calendar_feed.contains: Your calendar sees the title, time and place plus a link to Bunprise — never guests, wishes or reservations.
calendar_feed.secret: You get a secret address for this. Anyone who knows it can see these events — don’t share it.
calendar_feed.unavailable: The calendar subscription isn’t available yet.
calendar_feed.address_once: The address is shown only now. For another device, copy it now or create a new one later.
calendar_feed.google_steps: On a computer at calendar.google.com: next to “Other calendars” click “+” → “From URL” → paste the address → “Add calendar”.
calendar_feed.google_slow: Google refreshes subscribed calendars rarely — often only every 12 to 24 hours. Apple Calendar and Outlook are faster.
calendar_feed.outlook: Outlook: “Add calendar” → “Subscribe from web” → paste the address.
calendar_feed.never_fetched: Not fetched by any calendar yet.
calendar_feed.shown_once: For security we show the address only once. If you need it again, create a new one.
calendar_feed.rotate_message: The current address stops working right away. Calendars using it won’t get updates anymore.
calendar_feed.stop_message: The address stops working right away. Calendars subscribed to it keep the old entries until you remove the subscription there.
calendar_feed.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again in a moment.
calendar_feed.offline: You need an internet connection for this.
calendar_feed.demo: Demo: the address is only an example and doesn’t work.
